## What this changes

<!-- One or two sentences. Link the issue it closes, if there is one. -->

## Why

<!-- The behaviour that was wrong, or the task that was not possible. For an
     Office construct, say what Word, Excel, or PowerPoint does with it. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] The affected targets build, and the relevant CTest layer passes.
- [ ] Tests cover the change — a failing test that now passes, not only a
      smoke test.
- [ ] No generated churn: `git diff` shows nothing unexpected under
      `include/ExyokiOffice/DOM`, `sources/DOM`, `sources/Packaging`, or
      `data/`. No file carrying the `<auto-generated>` banner is edited by hand;
      the generator in `gen/` is changed instead.
- [ ] Public headers document new API, including what it does when it fails.
- [ ] `docs/Compatibility.md` reflects any change to what is supported.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry for anything a user would notice.
- [ ] `clang-format` is clean (`.\WinLint.ps1 -Changed -Tool Format -Check`).
